note: Redwood state park in west Marin, 15 miles west of San Rafael on Sir Francis Drake Blvd. Camp Taylor has two loops under the redwoods along Lagunitas Creek: Creekside, where RV-length sites 2-6 sit by the creek and the rest are tent sites, and Orchard Hill, which holds most of the RV-length pads. Trailers are limited to 27 ft. Creek access is closed from Dec 1 to June 15 each year for spawning coho and steelhead, and fishing is no longer allowed. Generators 10 a.m.-8 p.m. only; hammocks prohibited. The paved Cross Marin Trail runs through the park. --Claude
